archetypes.name: dyn-agent-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces a read-only external-agent evidence and result boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect evidence-directory containment, symlink and regular-file checks, exact Claude argv, and launcher-owned result persistence. Verify untrusted prompt and model output cannot escape the intended read-only surface or forge handled state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
